real_pairing: Seeded permutation of all 300 original validation recordings, consecutive pairs; each one-second recording padded to the two-second event clock
conditional_pairs: All ten digit values as first event; second event (digit+1) mod 10
secondary: Unrestricted target-free Vosk, retain literal words and errors, no homophone relabeling
negative_baseline: Successful generated [0,1] bundle; if it fails, all negative-control claims are unqualified
word_excision: Remove the first actual Whisper-observed digit-word interval and 80ms margin from real PCM; keep carrier and complete sample clock
qualification_scopes: Report general real-speech ASR eligibility and bounded canonical-output-profile eligibility separately; neither substitutes for the other
